workflows.yaml:
name: NBA research postgame coordinator

# First-cycle final statistics and catch-up only. Recurring pregame issuance is
# NOT_IMPLEMENTED. This never dispatches or changes the frozen first producer.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 13 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      cycle_id:
        description: Fixed first-cycle identifier for owner catch-up
        required: true
        type: string
        default: NBA-SDV-DAILY-001-20261023-401909094

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: nba-sdv-daily-001-20261023-401909094-writer
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  postgame:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'NickNicky19/Nicks-multisport-lab-project' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      (github.event_name == 'schedule' ||
       (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.actor == 'NickNicky19'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Prepare existing repository authentication
        run: gh auth setup-git
      - name: Recover first-cycle originals and process admitted final evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m multisport_lab.sdv_postgame_runner run \
            --work-root "$RUNNER_TEMP/nml-nba-operations"
      - name: Preserve factual report and bounded emergency originals
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: nba-postgame-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          include-hidden-files: false
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/nml-nba-operations/execution-report.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/nml-nba-operations/state/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/nml-nba-operations/originals/

workflow.name: Owner manual daily-snapshot NBA research cycle

workflows.yaml:
name: Owner manual daily-snapshot NBA research cycle

# This has no schedule. Merging this file does not authorize or start a cycle.
# A later explicit owner approval and correctly bound manual dispatch are needed.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      cycle_id:
        description: Exact approved daily-snapshot cycle ID
        required: true
        type: string
      producer_commit:
        description: Exact reviewed producer source commit (40 lowercase hexadecimal characters)
        required: true
        type: string
      confirmation:
        description: APPROVE followed by the exact cycle ID and producer commit
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: nba-sdv-daily-001-20261023-401909094-writer
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  research-cycle:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'NickNicky19/Nicks-multisport-lab-project' &&
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      github.actor == 'NickNicky19'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      NML_PRODUCER_COMMIT: ${{ inputs.producer_commit }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Prepare existing GitHub authentication for the single records writer
        run: gh auth setup-git
      - name: Verify owner approval, capture, issue and independently recover
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m multisport_lab.sdv_daily_runner run \
            --mode prospective \
            --cycle config/sdv_daily_cycle_v1.json \
            --producer-commit "$NML_PRODUCER_COMMIT" \
            --records-branch records/sdv-daily-001-20261023-401909094 \
            --work-root "$RUNNER_TEMP/nml-sdv-daily"
      - name: Preserve factual completion or failure evidence without publishing
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: sdv-daily-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          include-hidden-files: false
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/nml-sdv-daily/execution-report.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/nml-sdv-daily/state/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/nml-sdv-daily/originals/
